verdict.rationale: Brex's partner onboarding docs say approved applicants receive credentials for a staging environment, so a non-production test environment exists. The only evidence is that single gated mention: it is tied to partner application approval and gives no detail on test data, simulated transactions, or general self-serve availability. Missing for 10: self-serve sandbox access for all API users, documentation of sandbox scope and test data, a sandbox mode for the MCP server or agent workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration.
